title: feat(console): Setup gets one Packages entry, the package list's administration face; Installed Apps retires
body:
<!-- claude-projects-attribution: {"github_login":"os-support-ai"} -->
_Requested by **Yibo Wang** · [project thread](https://claude.ai/code/project/chan_01BVUyyPie8gHwoPM18iABwB?thread=cmsg_01BVUyyPie8gHwoPM18iABwB9qsP28anD5tWRUHq8j1xSU)_

Fixes #36834

Clause-②: no
Metadata-protocol: none

## 维护者速读

- 管理员在「系统设置 → 应用」里多了一个「软件包」入口，能看到本系统装的全部软件包，可启用、停用、删除；原来的「已安装应用」入口去掉了。
- 落实你在软件包入口这张卡上的裁定：设置里只做管理，设计仍在 Studio。
- 出错时管理员在设置里看不到或误操作软件包；改动只在界面和导航，撤回这次合并即可恢复原样。
- 无

## What changes

**The face selector: the URL parameter `face=admin`.** Setup's entry is a component nav item with `params: { face: 'admin' }`, and the sidebar sends a component entry's `params` as the query string, so the entry opens `.../component/developer/packages?face=admin`. With no `face`, the page is the development surface exactly as before (Studio's "All packages" link and each package card's Manage). An old address with `source=marketplace` and no `face` (bookmarks, and the marketplace page's "Installed" button) also reads as the administration face. A `face` value other than `admin`, or a repeated `face`, is refused by name (`PACKAGES_FACE_UNKNOWN` / `PACKAGES_FACE_REPEATED`), the same way the page already refuses a bad `source`. No new page, widget, hook or route.

**The gate: `requiredPermissions: ['manage_platform_settings']`**, the pattern Setup's Settings hub (`nav_settings_hub`) and Public Forms use. The server still checks every package write with `manage_metadata`.

- **Setup → Apps → Packages (`nav_packages`).** `@objectstack/platform-objects` contributes the one entry to `group_apps`, unfiltered, translated in all 11 Setup locales (zh-CN: 软件包).
- **The administration face**, built from the old Installed Apps view and extended to every source:
  - It lists every package of every source, with modules folded under their app. Platform packages (system / cloud) stay hidden.
  - It has a Source filter (All / Code / Marketplace / Authored) that writes `?source=` and keeps `face`. Only marketplace rows are asked about updates.
  - Its one header action is New Package. A package created there opens in Studio at `/studio/ID/data`, the address the Studio landing's package card opens (`BuilderLanding`'s `open`).
  - The detail sheet offers View info, Disable / Enable and Delete, and Delete keeps the keep-data choice. An authored package also gets "Open in Studio".
  - Not offered: Import, Edit, Publish, Revert, Export, Duplicate, Adopt loose items, and the pending changes' Publish / Discard.
- **Installed Apps retires.** `MARKETPLACE_INSTALLED_UI_BUNDLE` no longer carries `nav_marketplace_installed`. It stays exported under its id, with `navigationContributions: []`, so cloud's import keeps compiling and registering it. The entry's labels leave the Setup bundle and its id joins the dead-key tombstone.
- The comments that cited ruling 甲 as the reason Setup had no entry (`setup-nav.contributions.ts`, `BuilderLanding.tsx`, `marketplace-ui.ts`) now cite this card's amendment.

### Readers of `nav_marketplace_installed` in this repo

| Reader | What happened |
|---|---|
| `packages/cloud-connection/src/marketplace-ui.ts` | entry removed; the bundle is now **empty** (no pages, no contributions) |
| `packages/cloud-connection/src/marketplace-installed-ui-entry.pin.test.ts` | restated as an absence pin |
| `packages/platform-objects/src/apps/setup-nav.contributions.ts` | comment rewritten |
| 11 Setup translation files + 10 `*.source-hashes.ts` | key replaced by `nav_packages` |
| `translations/setup-nav-dead-key-tombstone.test.ts` | id added as dead |
| `packages/cloud-connection/CHANGELOG.md`, `packages/platform-objects/CHANGELOG.md` | release-owned history, untouched |
| `docs/qa/platform-checklist/areas/platform-core.json` | stale checklist text naming the entry; outside this card's file surface, see Acceptance notes |

Code that imports `MARKETPLACE_INSTALLED_UI_BUNDLE` still compiles, unchanged: `packages/cli/scripts/check-app-nav-i18n.mjs`, `packages/qa/dogfood/test/platform-app-object-entry-views.test.ts`, and the package index export.

### Read first (by risk)

1. `ui/packages/app-shell/src/views/metadata-admin/PackagesPage.tsx`. Look at the `authoring` switch in `PackageDetailSheet`, the `adminFace` branches in the header and toolbar, and `onCreated`.
2. `ui/packages/app-shell/src/views/metadata-admin/packageSource.ts`, `readPackagesFace`, which reads the legacy `source=marketplace` address as the admin face.
3. `packages/cloud-connection/src/marketplace-ui.ts`. The bundle is now empty but keeps its id.

### Two-minute check

Boot any example as admin and open Setup. Under 应用 there are 软件包 and 浏览应用市场, and no 已安装应用. Click 软件包: the list shows the 来源 filter and a single 新建软件包 button, with no 导入 button.

## Why

The maintainer's ruling on #36834 amends ruling 甲 of #25098. Setup is where an administrator sees what is installed and turns it on, off or away. Designing a package stays in Studio. The marketplace-only Installed Apps entry was a narrower copy of the same list, so it merges into the new entry's Source filter.

## Verification

Live on `examples/app-showcase` (`objectstack dev --seed-admin`, own port and file DB), signed in as `admin@objectos.ai`. The console is the `ui/apps/console` Vite dev server on the current `ui/` source, proxied to that backend, and was driven with Playwright in zh-CN.

- **Served nav** (`GET /api/v1/meta/app?id=setup`): one `nav_packages`, with `componentRef: developer:packages`, `params: {face: admin}` and `requiredPermissions: [manage_platform_settings]`. No `nav_marketplace_installed` appears in the response.
- **Setup → 应用 → 软件包** opens `?face=admin`. It shows the heading 软件包, the admin description, a 新建软件包 button, no 导入 button, and rows of every source (代码 and 自建).
- **Filter**: 应用市场 sets `&source=marketplace` and shows the empty-marketplace state, because the showcase has no marketplace installs. 代码 and 自建 each narrow the list. 全部 clears `source` and stays on `face=admin`.
- **Old link**: `/apps/setup/component/developer/packages?source=marketplace` opens the admin face, with the 应用市场 chip on and 新建软件包 present.
- **New package**: 新建软件包, enter a name, save. The page lands on `/studio/com.default.field-service/data` and shows the toast 已创建软件包「Field Service」.
- **Detail (authored package)**: the sheet's buttons are exactly 查看信息 / 禁用 / 删除软件包 / 关闭, plus the link 在 Studio 中打开 to `/studio/com.default.dogfood-alpha/data`. These are absent: 编辑, 发布, 还原, 导出, 复制, 导入, 放弃, 收编散落项.
- **Disable, then enable**: after 禁用 and confirm, the sheet shows 软件包已禁用。, the status reads 已禁用, and the button turns to 启用. After 启用, it shows 软件包已启用。 and the button turns back to 禁用.
- **Delete keeping data**: `DELETE /api/v1/packages/com.default.dogfood-alpha?keepData=true` returned 200. **Delete everything**: `DELETE /api/v1/packages/com.default.dogfood-beta` returned 200. Each time the sheet closed and the row left the list.
- **Studio unchanged**: its 全部软件包 link opens the page with no `face`, with no Source picker and with the 导入 and 新建软件包 buttons. The same package's sheet keeps 查看信息 / 编辑 / 发布 / 还原 / 禁用 / 导出 / 复制 / 收编散落项 / 删除软件包.

Screenshots (zh), in the project files under `issue-36834/`:

- `setup-packages-list-zh.png`: the Setup list
- `setup-packages-detail-zh.png`: the Setup detail sheet of an authored package
- `setup-packages-detail-code-zh.png`: a code package's sheet (View info only; code packages are read-only)
- `setup-packages-disabled-zh.png`: the feedback after a disable
- `setup-packages-marketplace-zh.png`: the list filtered to marketplace
- `setup-packages-delete-keepdata-zh.png`: the delete dialog with the keep-data choice
- `setup-new-package-lands-in-studio-zh.png`: New Package landed in Studio
- `studio-packages-detail-unchanged-zh.png`: Studio's sheet with every action

## Tests

These ran on head `bb10cd3592`.

<details><summary>Package tests and type-checks</summary>

- `@objectstack/platform-objects`: `pnpm test` gave 125 files / 2138 tests passed; `typecheck` passed.
- `@objectstack/cloud-connection`: `pnpm test` gave 94 files / 1359 tests passed (lock VERDICT command-exit 0); `typecheck` passed.
- UI, `pnpm --dir ui exec vitest run` over `metadata-admin/PackagesPage*` and `studio-design/BuilderLanding*`: Test Files 33 passed (33), Tests 284 passed (284) (lock VERDICT command-exit 0).
- `@object-ui/i18n` tests: 109 files passed. `type-check` passed for `@object-ui/app-shell` and `@object-ui/i18n`.
- `pnpm check:app-nav-i18n`: OK, with 14 contributors and 11 locales. Setup has 62 merged nav ids, each labelled in every locale.

</details>

<details><summary>Ablation (one-off, not kept)</summary>

After committing the fix, `const authoring = face !== 'admin';` in `PackageDetailSheet` was replaced with `const authoring = true;`. The replacement was made through `scripts/ablation-replace.mjs`, with an anchor-hit check and a trap restore. The test "the detail sheet offers View info, Disable and Delete…" went red (1 failed). After the restore, the blob matched HEAD and `git diff HEAD` was empty.

</details>

<details><summary>Derived gate families</summary>

`node scripts/pm/dispatch-gates.mjs --ran` reported: 78 derived, 78 run, 0 NOT-MEASURED, a derived zero, because every run recorded an exit code and none was 3. CI runs the rest of the farm.

The local union ran on `bb10cd3592`. All 77 `--commands` families and `pnpm --dir ui exec vitest run scripts/` (Test Files 172 passed, 2 skipped; Tests 5127 passed) exited 0.

Two of them needed a retry:

- `check:type-check-debt` first returned queue-timeout 99, because a sibling run held the verify lock. The retry under the same slot exited 0.
- `check:dual-build-cjs-loads` was red on the first pass. The cause was a half-built local `@objectstack/organizations` dist, a package outside this diff. After rebuilding it, the gate exited 0 with 124 entry points.

Changeset families: `check-adr-0087-registration`, `check-changeset-no-major`, `check-empty-changeset` and `check:changeset-gate-self-tests` all exited 0.

</details>

- **Fix round 1 (head 35bdb5ba).** CI's Test Core (1/10) was red at bb10cd35 in `packages/cli/test/connect-agent-both-halves-wire.pin.test.ts` (35 expected, 37 got). The CLI composition has no marketplace, so on main `group_apps` was empty there and got collapsed; `nav_packages` makes it served again. The two new served Setup ids are `group_apps` and `nav_packages`. The pin now restates the exact count 37 in both tests, with a history line citing #36834, and asserts that `group_apps`'s children equal `['nav_packages']`. Local runs: the four Setup pins 4/4 files and 10/10 tests; platform-objects 125 files and 2138 tests. Delta comment 7128676644. That test file is outside the claim's file surface, and the edit was directed by the fix-round order.
- Open draft PR #34223 restates the same count in that pin. It already conflicts with main on its own; whichever lands second re-counts.

## Acceptance notes

- **Delete's feedback** is the sheet closing and the row leaving the list. Both faces already behaved this way, and no success notice was added, because a notice would change the development face too. Disable and Enable give an inline notice.
- **A code package's sheet** offers View info only. Code packages are read-only, as they were before, so Disable and Delete appear on authored and marketplace packages.
- **Stale QA checklist text.** `docs/qa/platform-checklist/areas/platform-core.json` (around lines 2393, 2404 and 2441) still describes the retired Installed Apps entry. It is outside this card's file surface and is left for the checklist owner.
- **Cloud.** The cloud repository's import of `MARKETPLACE_INSTALLED_UI_BUNDLE` (cloud PR #3488) keeps compiling. The bundle now contributes nothing, so whether cloud drops the import is cloud's call.

## Human Minimum

- [x] 1. Schemas start as Zod; `packages/spec` holds no runtime logic.
- [x] 2. Every name I added uses the casing for its kind.
- [x] 3. No formatter ran; `pnpm lint` passes. (Not run locally: the repo-wide lint is CI's run.)
- [x] 4. One issue, one branch off an up-to-date `main`, one pull request.
- [x] 5. A change that publishes carries a changeset, and both declaration lines are filled in here and in the changeset.
- [x] 6. `packages/spec` touched: its generated artifacts are regenerated and committed. (Not touched.)
- [x] 7. No hand edits to `content/docs/references/`, `packages/*/CHANGELOG.md` or `content/docs/releases/`.
- [x] 8. Title, body and comments are in English.
- [x] The *Before Submitting* list in CONTRIBUTING.md is done.
